content:
My heart wrenches
With the thought of losing you.
A slight distance thought
Passes through—
That you will leave me someday,
And all that glittery gold
Is just a dust,
That smoulders with my tears,
And with the wind
It all perishes away.

One day
You will just be a distant memory,
Every time we spent together
Just a story
That I will keep repeating
Again and again,
But just in my head,
My dreams,
And my thoughts only.

For one day
You will leave me adrift
On my own glory,
And I know
The exact amount of pain
I will go through that day—
Just a hundred
Or thousand times more
The pain
I’ve gone through.

For you live
In my days,
My nights,
And the in-betweens,
But that day
I’ll have you lost
By all the means.

I shake
As I see the day
In clear sight sometimes—
On days you hate me,
On times
When none shines.

When no matter
How much I love you,
Your heart
Will not approve,
Blocks all my feelings
Just to disapprove.
I see immense hatred,
I see immense guilt,
For having me
In your life
With nothing
But regret.

And that’s when
I sense my worth in you,
And my heart
Always wrenches
With the thought
Of losing you.

content:
I struggle to find peace in the chaos
For these days, I have been captivated
Engulfed deep within the whirlpool of madness
The one where uncertainty feels aggrevated

Lately, I find myself serenading in isolation
Not to the beats of joy nor those of happiness
For mere melancholy of sadness and betrayal remain
Drowning me deep into the world of darkness

As I retrospect, I see myself - a complete soul
Quite opposite to what defines me as of now
And slowly as I try to pen down my thoughts
I run out of words to portray somehow

For I'm lost in the world of chasers today
Where every single one fights their way through
And here I am trying to figure out my own chase
For I'm unbeknownst to the role I'd play to

Well I'm scared for I see no hope in my heart
The one that once had been sowed deep
But before the reap, it got thrashed so hard
And wretched I fell, just scared to leap
Forever scared to take a faith leap!

content: THE GIANT LEAP
Dear soul,

You need not feel the pain anymore
For you've broken all the walls for it
And from the depths of crevases you've fallen
Like a phoenix you've risen and flown from it!

You need not fear any longer
For you've overcome the toughest you know
The hardest of extremes and mightiest of all
Outreached them all, steady and slow

I wonder what you desire dear?
For now no pain or fear holds you down
Why do you still choose to linger here?
Why curse the life? Or choose to frown?

Go conquer, endulge, explore
Don't let yourself perish in sore
For life's the way it is and will always be
Choose your take - how it's supposed to be!
Dear soul,

You know your dreams, your rise and fall
You know your mountains, so climb them all
For it's no time to die, no time to weep
But to take the risk  and make a leap!
Just make a leap!

If only it was as easy as said
To just let go of them, you cared for
For they are not just ones you loved
But those you've changed your dreams for!
And those you've let go "you" for!

content: For the Stranger....
Dear Stranger,

All those times, over an year
I’ve seen what you’ve gone through
All those times, of utmost fear
I’ve seen how you’ve fought too

Every evening, as you step to the attic
You stare into those skies - a bit far in the horizon
Every time, I step into my attic
I search for your smiles - in hopes of liaison

I've seen you burn those cigarettes down
Occasionally getting drunk too
I’ve heard you wail and swear in frown
Of reasons I’m unknown to

And often I've caught you look at me
With glimpses that summon me
Those eyes that seek of help and plea
To fix it all if may be

But today was the worst I realized
As you drenched yourself to the rain
I saw you cry, teared up those eyes
I saw you giving up to the pain
But dear stranger,

Did you see the glow of sun back then?
Or the hues of the skies that spoke to you
Of little sunshine despite the rain
Spoke hopes and dreams that come true
Trust me,

We are all going through the same
We’re all hurt in one way or two
So it’s not fair to quit the game
But live it all up, like champions do
Like champions do!

content: From FOMO to JOMO

I was not always like this
This is not who I used to be ..

I used to live in the crowds
I used to love the hustle
Was in love of those sounds
Watched the city life  bustle

Loud music, was what I danced to
Loud parties, my hearts belonged to
Loud laughters, of all those gags too
Loud colors, I even vibed to

But now,
I am not who I used to be

For once there was a time
When I feared of being left out
In fear of getting alone
Often, I even stressed out

For now I seek peace in staying inside
Aloof from the chaos just strayed aside
And in solitude, I lay just calm beside
Like a sail on the shore, thrashed by riptide
It's quite a huge change you see

For a person who was always so busy
Now, I find peace in doing and being nothing
For a person for whom once talking was easy
I find silence - a retreat; passivity a thing

I've fallen more in love
But with nature than ever
The beauty of skies,
The clouds and the river

I wonder if there's ever going back
To way the things were and used to be
For it's been more than just a knack
Of how things were always supposed to be

For everything has changed
And every time that used to be

And I was not always like this
This is not who I used to be
Not who I used to be.

content: The Second Wave

Just when the chaos settled down a bit,
You fetched a storm - a lot stronger

Just when the world calmed down albeit,
You crashed a wave - a lot longer

Who would have thought, it would be so bad?
For all I see, is perishing hopes and frailties around

Who would have thought, it would be so sad?
For all I hear is wails and just a siren's sound

And each time, I see someone staring at the horizon
Every hour, taking puffs and weeping at his own loss

Each time, I see someone giving up on their dreams and loved one
Losing faith upon their religion, even cursing their own gods

A million lives you took this time,
A million homes you destroyed too

A million dreams just left unchased
A million hopes you smashed too

Left a hole in heart somewhere,
But all we can do is stay strong
Stay safe, gain strength, build courage too
For times too dire won't last long
Shan't last long!

content: An Awaited Meet

If only the paths we take ever converge into one
If not all along, may be at a point or two

I'd wait for the day, may be a mile ahead in time
In hopes of getting just a glimpse of you

Like a perfect dawn, when sun just meets the sky
I'd sync my time to make my way to you

And like the rolling clouds soak the golden hue
I'd drown rather in the love, you'd bestow

These days, I wonder what it felt like being with you
For you reside mostly in my memory - a bit distant and dreamy

Your presence, your smile, your charms, your style
More like a morning haze, smoked up yet steamy

If only the times we had, could ever be turned back
If not every moment, just a minute or two

Of those where our eyes met, or hands held together
I'd leave my heart right there, loop it all through

But now, I'm left yearning for the time to come
But perhaps the destiny keeps diverging us apart,

And yet I keep dreaming,  of our meet at times
Never giving up, still keeping that hope alive in heart..
The hope alive in heart !

When I dreamt of getting older
Freedom, wisdom, power and roles

For in the end, it's heaven's way,

If calm you stay..
Patiently ..

Do you smile as often as you did?
Think you did much, and did succeed?

How much of the life is left in you?
Do you still dream to touch the sky?
With zeal enough to make you fly?

How much of feels do you feel now?

For when you stop living, you make the void
The void of no desires, no feelings, no care
And that's when you start to get the fear
Of falling in love with this darkness and embracing it all
And never going back to who you once were

What do you wanna be,
When u grow old?
What would a child know;
That is left to see
Yet she had to be bold

If only had they taught
What the dreams were like
She would perhaps have flown
Somewhere so high
Like the flock of birds and be alike
Spreading up her wings on her own

But She was rather pushed
To the paths unknown
Along the flocks and herds
Undestined to be
Well, now she ended up all alone
Confused, distressed and lost
Struggling for words

Now all she aspires
Is to live a "normal" life
Ordinary dreams; average times
However, is it even possible?

For the world only belongs
To those who win the strife

Not those who wait to get their times;
But leap forward to make their times!

Whence you hear that call
Of one upon the beating heart

No reason, no care
And yet you sense the feel and fear

Not of real space though
But of interests and keen

But no matter what
I choose to stay
Despite the truths
I wouldn't sway

Only in hopes,
I choose to cling along
Hold on through it all,
Where my heart belong

For it's now with you,
My smiles
My dreams
My peace
My hope
And I belong!

content: THE PAUSE

Do you ever wish to take a pause?
And glance upon the way your life is?
Sit still and calm by the shore,
And see it flow and glide with ease

Life can get tough sometimes
You might feel overwhelmed too
Stressed out of thoughts and tough times
Drowned down, you might even feel through
At such times,

Do you not wish you were somewhere else?
Somewhere near but not there
Watching at the next version of your own self
Wishing you dealt life with much care
Well, I do..

Often take those mini pauses in between
Just to see the life pass by and around
To reflect upon; the way it has been
And keep peace in mind to stay sound

And that's when life starts making sense
Just a race in time with no end or win
A subtle mix of gentle and intense
A depth too deep to dive within!

content: Before I bid Adieu!

As the early morning breeze,
Gently hit through my eyes
And woke me up to my dream
The pristine lake as the sun rise
Flowing steadily to its seam

So calm and peaceful,
so smooth the flow
Those waves carried away
My train of thoughts aside in throw
As I slowly made the sway

And Once the beam of light it hit
Magic, it was the show
Of diamonds shining bright as lit
The waves flow, high and low

As flocks of swans came swimming by
And danced upon the lake
Left mesmerized, awestruck in high
Of beauty - much to take

And as I saw horizon far
Could see the sails make row
Silhouetted against the morning star
Floating along the flow

With every ounce of coffee I sipped
Could see it change its hue
Wished I could take my plunge and dipped
Into this serene view

Before I bid adieu
To this majestic view!

What does it come with?
Dreams that come true?
Or rather who you are with?

Like you can engulf it all at once
Or rather in pieces
Mixed up with some bitterness

Whence I choose often to pause the sense of time

And in the depths of time I choose to dive
Rewind the good times, and wait again..
Once more to arrive!

content: The Ambivalence of Isolation
Yes, it feels more alive

To embrace this freedom of being with myself
This time wherein I choose to be me
And fear not of being judged for being oneself
Yes, it feels so peaceful

To be away from the never ending chaos of people around
Of being surrounded by vexing talks and noises
And filter all the stares of the soul feeding hound
Yes, it feels alright

To be cast away from the worldly duties and responsibilities
Spend time on my own and love myself a little more
And explore a little more of mine unacknowledged abilities
But, does it feel good enough?

To be always reminding yourself that you're doing just fine
Not affected of the echoes of silence at all
And not hindered by the darkness and yearned for the shine
Does it not feel lonely?

To be captivated to one’s fears and be shadowed under
Living up with vague memories of what you had
And to live a dull life, lost all the thunder
Do you not yearn?

To see those smiles, and hear those laughter over cups of tea
Of those tiny infinities of joy and love in share
Do you not miss those days, or is it.. just me?

content: केही दिन अघिको कुरा हो

जब तिमीलाई लेख्ने हरेक चिठ्ठीमा
अट्न सक्दैनन् थिए मेरा अनेकन् भावनाहरू
शब्दकोश नै ओल्टाईपल्टाई खोजेतापनि
समेट्न नसक्ने थिए ती मेरा पत्रहरू

जब तिमीलाई एक क्षण भेट्न भनी
प्रतिक्षामै थकित हुन्थिए यी नयनहरु
साथ हुँदा तिम्रै ती कुराकानी सुनेर
हराउने गर्थे मेरा होष र हवासहरु
तर आज खोई के भएछ हामीलाई

एकान्तको मोहमा परिएछ कि खोई
आज रित्तिँदै छन् मेरा शब्दहरू
लेख्न खोज्छु चिठ्ठी फेरि तर
चल्दै चल्दैनन् आज यी हातहरु

परिस्थितिले ल्याएको यो दूरी बीच
सम्झनामा सीमित छन् तिम्रो यादहरु
कल्पना र विपनाको भेदमा
दोहोरिंदै छन् तिम्रै सपनाहरू।।
Translation:
A few days back...

When every single letter that I used to write to you,
Could never suffice to express my feelings for you
Even though I turned a million pages in a dictionary
No words could be gathered to express my love to you

When even the smallest of meets with you
Would make so anticipated that my eyes were often so tired
And when we were together,
I'd be so lost in your talks and stories
That I would lose me and my conscious right there
But what happened to us now?

May be we are so in love with this loneliness
and it's charm that
Now I struggle to find any words for you
Even though I try hard to write a letter to you,
My hands won't start writing anymore

May be it's the distance that the situation has brought in that
All we have now are those memories and moments of you
Stuck in between reality and delusion
Now all I ever do is recurrently dream of only you!

content:
Do you ever feel captivated?
Deep into your own pool of thoughts
Where you sink into the bottom
And struggle to afloat again

Do you too feel strangled?
By knots and tangles of ruth negativity
Where you're bound so tight
And struggle to let loose again

Confused are you too from within
Indecisive of what you want and wish to do
Variant choice and variant moods
Are you too, afraid to choose one?

Do you also feel isolated?
Despite being lost in the crowd
Among the million voices to be heard
Alone / aloof; are you still low?

Well,
May be,
It just happens sometimes...
When you're in the depths of darkness
You do loose your rhymes

But nevertheless,
The point is to never loose yourself
Hold on tight and cling on if you might
until one day you see the light and take your flight!

content: Just me!

How do we know if we ever know
How heavy does our hearts ever feel
How do we feel if we ever could
How much of that heart needs to heal

I struggle a lot, a little more often
In finding just the right emotions,
For little do I know, how do I feel
Struggle to filter out wrong notions

Is it even legit, to learn to not let go
Conform does it to the general norms
Is it even legit, to feel sad even though
Shall it lead to good in some forms

I often end up questioning myself why
I end up being affected so much at all
Of all the worldly things going around
Why do I struggle to build up that wall

But then I realize, may be it's all for the good
Ever hath they happened, hath been a should
For not all emotions are to be shown,
Not all notions to be judged,
Not all hands to be let gone,
Nor all feelings to be grudged

For life's all about this long journey you take
Of friends you find, memories you make
And it's never too wrong, to not know the why
Let's go with the flow, as time flows by ...

Take journey of life just go with the flow
A small little step, each day as you go
For life is no life with a hand to hold on
Of best ones; do keep, before they are gone
Before it's all gone!

By the shore of Mersey river
I wandered all alone

How soothing would it be

content: COLLABORATIVE POEM WRITING  WITH @_deepsana_ Please Click Read more

If Tomorrow was Yesterday
If tomorrow was yesterday,
How would you live life?
Would you live it for the sake of it?
Or, would you add a little more life to it?

If only tomorrow was yesterday,
The best of lives, would I have lived
Not just to thrive, but to succeed
For my own dreams, more would I heed

If tomorrow was yesterday,
How would you do things?
Would you still be brave and take that lead?
Or, would you lose heart and just leave?

If only tomorrow was yesterday
I'd not have let things go by
Grasped those chances, not be so shy
And acted strongly, made no cry

If tomorrow was yesterday,
I believe, you would be firmer
Would let no man tell you otherwise
Stand on your ground and hold your head higher

But, even if tomorrow was yesterday,
Am scared if times would repeat again
Of harsh - those words and all the pain
Of all the storms, that came with rain

But thankfully,
Tomorrow can never be yesterday
For deeds decided should be done
And paths destined must be walked on

Even if, tomorrow was to be yesterday
Shall I only be better than what I'd been
For deeds been wrong, are all been seen
And only shall I work some more
To make good win
Let goodness reign!

content: SPRING IN THE TIME OF CORONA 🤘 100TH POST 🤘

Empty streets, abandoned park
Silent roads, so eerie - dark!

No more: the walks, nor children play
No souls are found, along this way

All alone, all trapped, in homes
And in the wild, nature blossoms

All vivid, alive they thrive
As the season of spring does arrive

Alas! No praise; none to admire
The beauty laid blue, left off dire

For the time will go and soon it's gone
Don't go until, to me, it's shown

For every year, this time of year
I wait by to visit them near

To see those blossoms come to life,
With joys everywhere and end of strife
The end of strife!

content: REACHING UP

Hey you!
How've you been holding on?
Lost your grip on world, have you?
Or somehow you could fight along?

Did you too dream to touch the sky?
Like all, did you too aim so high?
Without a doubt or question why;
Forgot to live: while made the try?

Ignored too did you on your wants,
Silenced your heart against its rants?
Lost and hurt bad, them - the loved ones
Did you betray or tricked them once?

How far you've gone to reach that height?
Felt low and weak along the fight,
And while you did, forgot what's Right,
And bent to wrongs, to make it bright?

But trust me, it's no worth in end!
Your deeds reflect in how life bend!
Nothing returns, despite you mend
Once lost the ones you love or friend.

Even if you grow enough so tall,
Shall you be more afraid to fall!
You stand aloof, against your wall
And end your life amidst it all

Only at last, shall you realize
What it took- for you just to rise
Only then, shall you be so wise
To get you were the one in price
Your life is what was on the price!

Down into a pool of potion
The one that when took just a sip,
Set a whirlpool of mixed emotion

Some of those memories, some of those tears,
Unravelling all the stories of fears

Nor shall those futile comments just drive into and pierce

If only such potion does do exist;
Give me a chance to engulp it all!
For it's all getting too arduous to persist
Let me drown to care just nothing at all !

content: The Dusk Vibes

Slowly and steadily:
As the cold breeze swept across her face,
She could feel her tears dry up
Soft fainted kisses atop with caress,
She could feel the pain fade off

With the hue of the sky painted so blue,
She could feel the peace within
As flocks chirped by and off they flew,
She could feel her fears give in

Right in that moment;
She wished if she could freeze it all
No grudges; no rooms for torment !
She wished she could send it all

But alas,
Time's not what that could be behold,
Nor was that freedom - that she often seeked
For dusks are whereafter nights unfold
And left her perfectly tricked !

Though each time, at this time she comes
Under the hood of millions and billions stars
In hopes of hope that she overcomes:
All of her bleeding scars,
And Clear all her mindwars!

content: STRANDED

You left me stranded
Halfway through the road
When everything sounded so good
When everything seemed so perfect
You left me hanging in there
Ending it all up to reach nowhere
I was there in the middle of the desert
Wailing for you to return back
But no replies; I was caged up
With no voice under control
Neither the situations and circumstances
I was rather so shocked
For I had never thought
That the day would come
Like the moon chase upon those stars
I would be set into this run
To reach just nowhere
Nowhere near your sight
For I really know you shall never return
Once you say that you're gone
And that you've been gone!

content: BOUND
Have you even dared ?
To survive like a prisoner
Of one's own thoughts and own dreams
Holding up against the world;
Yet smiling so wide and holding up the screams
Where freedom is not what you are gifted of;
But struggles and fears are
Where every decision is a compromise,
Where every path upon you step
Is what you despise
And yet you are to stay aput
Despite all your hues and cries
A world where you are your own culprit

Chosen to look above the sky and wish
To soar up high above those clouds
But alas! Not all birds are meant to fly
In depths of trees, rather so perfectly hiding
Tuning up the tones, sad song they sing
Of how they lack their fairy wing
And freedom to fly up all full swing!

Somewhere deep down the darkest cave
She laid aloof from all
Stayed safe away, saved of the wave
Of "Life" and all it's fall

No hopes, no aims, no goals to pave
No friends too close to call
Lost full herself, nothing to save
She was just a messed-up girl

For all above, the dark in-be
She still had got some hope
To live like all those lads; Envy
Forgot she's tied those rope

For what she dreamed was to be free
Fly soaring high above
But to dismay; just a spree
Forgot she's not the dove

But then came, to her life a light
A light distant too far
She chased it, more and more as bright
Got not near; Just a star

Tried too hard, tried all, to her might
Afraid to be left ajar
Cared not of what's wrong or the right
Jumped back to pit of tar

The light that raised her to believe
Just left her, just once more
For What broke her, was not it's berieve
But that it left her sore

Lost one more, true reasons to live
She felt left too ashore
Sad is not; it was meant to leave
Worse is she waits some more

On hopes that light she saw will live
Re-live if she searches more
In hopes that light guides to her eve
And swears to leave no more
TO STAY FOREVERMORE!

And held your hand

With you on top, me on the ground
Am still by your side, on wait for you
To turn around ; do you hear my sound?

Your shine, your charm and oh that smile!
All eyes on you, you’re still my admire
Now all that I can, is glance from far
With aches all over, and heart on fire

Return, will you? To the place we were
To sugars and sweets and love in air
Return to the moments, once were in our share
I swear we’d be back to the way we were

With tears on eyes, looked into you

At moments of our glee

Like those paper boats, we sailed down river

But now that we've grown, all faded away
Memories so vague, washed up in sway
Blurred up and smudged, those times we had
Now that we are parted, it's all so sad

But still in my mind, lasts your name

content: Stay... #TalesOfSeperation

On the brink of our times together
Fear is what I feel
For promises of staying forever
May not be even real

Those years of smiles and all those fun
Are bound to snatch away
As time speeds by and waits for none
Forks down our path and way

On the edge of times, I don't know how
Fell deep in love with you
But time's too cruel, never in bestow
Took you along with too

Now, that it's time to say goodbyes
Can't seem to hold my tears
It's past, that where my mind lingers
Moments you killed my fears

Glimpse and glitch is what remains
In just a year or two
Like lights from distant and those stains
Memories get faded too

In dreams, will where we meet and love
The only way we may be
But times when, there, I see you love,
Will you remember me?

True love knows no time they say
Too pure, no old to be
Like love in fairy tales just stay
Can't you too stay with me?

content: The Escape

Running deep into the woods,
I found myself alive
Out of chaos, under the hoods;
Silence and peace survive

Dizzied by daily chores of life
Hollowed by fears too big
Frustration, desolation: all been rife
Engulfed by dark, in swig

Broken dreams, crushed was heart
Sunk out self spirit and esteem
Believe in who? with trusts apart
In truth, I'd better deem

Escaped from it all and ran away
In hopes to find the lost I again
At place where joyful wind does play
Rhythms to soothe the soul in pain

And in amidst, the woods so deep,
Upon the skies, I saw an aura of light
Gleaming gold, showing hope to keep
That everything's indeed gonna be alright

content: Lost World

Lost in to the bizarre world of thoughts
Of sleepless nights and weird nightmares
Weak and fearsome to all the odds
Lonesome and tossed out like none would care

Solitude is what defines me the best
For it's where I reflect back myself upon
Keeping my life and my thoughts on test
Plunge deep to depths, I've never been drawn

Tangled, those threads, the threads of life
Crossed up and jumbled, but so am I
Battling hard; brain and heart on strife
Unknot those knots, should I at least try

Dark are those nights, with no light to see
Where wilderness surrounds me all over
Questions on questions, who I am bound to be
Dilemmas of paths; paths to recover

Lost in flight like those birds in the sky
Struggling at dusk, to find a shelter
Straggled; wandered to be up so high
Looking up to be nothing, but better!

Who are you and what you're to be
That's the question to ask within yourself, not me!
Are you the grand Mountain, that took a great stand
Or still weak? Like those sandstone, lying over the land

Of course, it's not easy, to be the mountain
Standing high above with glory, against all the pain
With every heights you take too, gets harder to breathe
But take a step, won't you? See the beauty beneath

Well it's easy to see those mountains, shining high up with pride
But lying deep within the beauty, lies the painful dark side
All we do is envy, the sparkle of snow that it hold
Little do we know of beats that it takes to be gold

It's not just about the beauty, but respect it gains
Rising above your own fears, to rise above those plains
Well, it's all about your own belief in the paths that you have lain

content: Days of Rain
#WithoutYou

I wonder why it happens, the way it does
The way weather always, reflects my mood,
Bright are those days, is my happiness the cause
At days that are dark, it  just won't feel good

Gloomy are those days, lonely that I feel
When pain is in my heart, that only you can heal
But rains are most delightful, the way it downpours
Cause it's when I miss you the most,and miss our daily chores

As every drop that drips, down the windowpane,
Reminds me of you; memories down the lane
Of how we have come, to be who we are
Of how did we link, to come to this far

Days we don't meet, are the coldest of all
No sight of your smile, nor your pleasant call;
And days you ignore, are darkest you know
The way I get hurt, far more than I show

May be rain's a part, a part of my story
Of no single glimpse of you, just bits of memory
Drunk as I am, with shots of caffeine
So Drunk in love, the way never been

See those drops fall, and count each of them
Is all that I do, unless that you came
Should hold up my tears, or should I let go

content: #FacingRealities
The Splash

May be I was too serene,
Too placid to know it all
For all I cared was myself,
And noticed no pain or call

Pacified, been all my life,
Stagnant to world around
Peace within, no cries or tears,
Been not too much profound

But may be life's not static they say;
Inevitably though,
You've got to move and take a lead,
And believe what you're through

When drops of water stirs the calm,
Rhythm is what you find
As thousand thoughts provoke you too,
You reach to depths of mind

A single splash of drop that's it,
Will get the waves to start
The drop's no just a drop that falls
And sinks to drift apart

Reality is not just smooth they say,
The waves of life you see
Cause life's all ups and downs you play,
Be best in what you can be

True peace is where the life moves on,
With waves of rise and fall
As drops fall upon and splash you hear,
It's pits of life you fall,

As drops fall upon and splash you hear;
You hear your life's call!

So beautiful and bright, so bold,

The beauty, that was never in your hold

The one you had wanted and all you pray

In pain, you see those hopes so bright!

Unique as you are; Just shine around
Rise up and flap your wings to ply

content: #DaysOfReminiscence
HOLD ON

It may not always be that easy,
for us to be together
But are bound by promises,
the ones that last forever

Never will I ever strand you along,
or will I cease to love
Promise, I'd hold on to you,
and give all that you deserve

Faith and trust and belief in you,
will never fade away
Trust me, I will stay a put for you,
not once will I sway

For you're the one I look into,
and will always look for when in tears
The one who makes me stronger,
and makes me fight back my fears

I may be weak, stumbled and fumbled at times,
may be too weak to stand
Different paths, and busy lives,
will you still hold my hand?

Now all I wish is to see you love, reaching above those height
Hold on to me like I hold on,
never to lose, that tight!

content: #ANewBeginning
Start of Something New

May be I was too obsessed,
Obsessed to live in the shadows
Aloof from all, a bit distressed,
Distressed by sadness and sorrows

Confused of all, no roads to take,
Baffled by choices of leads to make
No chance I got is no truth to say
Got too much, caught none; my dismay

Well may be it's me, who hid it all,
No courage, no strength to stand too tall,
Sealed words, kept shut, my doors of thought
Concealed within, too deep to be sought

But, once a ray of light came on
Pierced in through dark, in through the storm
Held up my hand, dragged me upon
Pushed me, to fly, spread wings up calm

And that's when life just took a turn
Afraid no more; get shined or burn
Unknot the knots, express it all
Share words and love, that's best my pal

And here, my journey starts again
This piece of word, to start new chain
Like buds in plants, bloom as they grew
I plan this start of something new
To set my path of dreams on due
